aggregation: For each method median of5weighted summed-call_ns and median of5smallbatch_ns. Warmup excluded; all5rounds retained.
complete_reads: Every call creates a new digest, opens and reads the complete file. No result/data/handle cache; buffer allocated per call.
criterion: Candidate qualifies iff production39-eligible, every hash correct, weightedmedian*100<=baselinemedian*95 AND smallmedian*100<=baselinesmallmedian*110. Rank qualifiers by weightedmedian,smallmedian,declared method order. No automatic production edit.
failure_rules: Any source/tool/protocol/corpus drift, wrong hash, missing/extra file, clock rollback, policy attempt, exception, capture failure or deadline makes experimentfailed; no candidate qualifies.
No tuning, retries, alternative corpus, skipped methods/rounds or recapture within this packet. Preserve partial raw data/failure.
Existing or unsafe output refuses; productionMigration IO denied for covered Python audit events; no OS/native filesystem sandbox claim.
file_digest_note: Python3.11+ measurement reference; not an unguarded Python3.9 production substitute.
generation: Create-only binary writes with1MiB generated chunks; no actual SDK/tool/model/source bytes.
independent_hashes: ExpectedSHA generated from logical pattern with65521-byte chunks; disk before/after SHA uses read_bytes independently, outside timing.
limits: Warm-cache local Windows/Python3.14.7 synthetic comparison, not cold storage, Android, device, model or service performance.
Balanced rotating orders reduce but do not eliminate background-load/cache/order effects; no cache flush or system settings.
Instrumentation overhead is included. Performance criteria do not replace correctness/regression tests.
measurement: perf_counter_ns; each weighted full method call includes safe_path/open/new SHA/read or readinto/close; sum10call_ns. Smallbatch timer includes all32full calls and result-list creation; correctness comparisons occur after timers.
pattern: Original repeating256 bytes: byte[i]=(73*i+19)%256; each file starts at pattern offset0.
readinto_count_guard: Actual e.require(type(count)is int and0<=count<=len(buffer),'invalid_hash_read') on every readinto result; positive short reads continue; EOFonly0; no retries. Guard overhead is timed.
safe_path: Same actual receipt_avd_environment.safe_path at the first executable operation of every method. Baseline invokes actual receipt_avd_environment.digest unchanged.
small_names: small/source-000.bin through small/source-031.bin, in index order

storage.retention: Keep corpus, protocol, runner, rawcaptures, source/tool pins and results. No recovery copy executed by comparison runner.
